reported.quote: Our revenue growth for Q2 was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% sequentially in constant currency terms.
Our revenue growth for Q2 was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% sequentially in constant currency terms.
For H1, revenue growth was at 1.9% in constant currency terms and 2.1% in reported terms.
EPS for the quarter stood at `19.32, up 8.7% on a Y-on-Y basis.
Large deals were another standout at $5.2 bn for the quarter.
This takes H1's total large deal wins to $8.8 bn, which is a YoY growth of 28% with 62% net new.
Net headcount increased by about 4,400 employees.

guidance.target: 1% to 2% YoY in constant currency terms
guidance.quote: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY .in constant currency terms.
Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.
